description: Negotiate the price of an OCKLU/TerTau digital product (id tertau-N). Send your offer in USD; the OCKLU seller agent answers instantly with accept or a counter-offer (max 3 rounds per product per day). If accepted you get a checkout link at the agreed price, valid 24 hours. Nothing is charged by this tool.
